# Component: data-table

**Purpose:** a sortable table of records.

The shared roster table, with no `**State:**` line at all. This is the branch
every pre-0.9 catalog entry hits — the line did not exist before the emanation
loop read one — so an absent lifecycle refuses with a remedy rather than
defaulting to a word the entry never said.

## API / Slots

| Prop / slot | What it carries |
|------|--------------------------|
| `rows` | the records to render |
